mentions.name: Lim — Browserbase for mobile
mentions.description: A cloud platform offering the 'Browserbase for mobile': real Android and iOS browser/device sessions at agentic scale with no concurrency limits. Devices run on bare metal (avoiding VM brittleness), are fully GPU-accelerated, and stream via WebRTC using hardware encoding. Currently behind a waitlist.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We’re building the Browserbase for mobile - Android & iOS at agentic scale with no concurrency limits.

We run them on bare metal without VM brittleness, fully GPU-accelerated with WebRTC streaming using hardware encoder.
